history: Same-season strictly earlier calendar dates; stored exact team identities; all games of a date predicted before histories are updated
formula: league=prior total runs/(2*prior games); attack=(team prior runs scored+20*league)/(team prior games+20); defense=(team prior runs allowed+20*league)/(team prior games+20); lambda_home=attack_home*defense_away/league, lambda_away=attack_away*defense_home/league; independent Poisson score distributions
ml_rule: Choose higher non-tie probability; condition on no tie for confidence; an observed tie is a push
threeway_rule: Choose highest of HOME, AWAY, DRAW; require unconditional probability >=0.75
external: Not opened unless development gate passes, then freeze and use genuinely new future evidence
tuning: One architecture and one threshold; no grids or result-dependent changes
